name: eec-resource-management-system
description: Ethiopian Engineering Corporation (EEC) Resource Management System (RMS)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "teal,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix backend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
